name_note: GTDB places this species in the genus Aquipseudomonas, while published work calls it Pseudomonas paracarnis; many genomes in this GTDB species carry the NCBI names Pseudomonas carnis or Pseudomonas fluorescens, and no retrieved source describes it at a human body site.

sentences.text: Pseudomonas paracarnis is a Pseudomonas species whose sequenced strains were isolated from refrigerated spoiled foods, including panela cheese that had turned blue.
It causes blue discoloration of fresh cheese, and gaseous ozone and ozonated mist have been tested to reduce its populations.
Pseudomonas strains in raw milk, among them Pseudomonas carnis isolates, hydrolyse milk proteins by producing extracellular metalloproteases.
